comments.author: @BeyondTheMapTV1
comments.text: Chile is extraordinary because geography creates completely different ways of life within the same country. 🇨🇱🌋 From the Atacama Desert to Patagonia, communities deal with drought, earthquakes, mountains and enormous distances in very different ways. The legacy of the 1960 Valdivia earthquake also makes Chile’s approach to seismic engineering and preparedness especially fascinating.
